title: AIExtractionOutput
description: Structured output from the AI financial report analysis (Spec D07 §4.2)

report_date.description: ISO 8601 date of the financial report, or null if not determinable

per.description: Price-to-Earnings ratio (trailing or reported), or null

roe.description: Return on Equity as a decimal fraction (e.g. 0.15 for 15%), or null

revenue_growth_yoy.description: Year-over-year revenue growth as a decimal (e.g. 0.08 for +8%), or null

analyst_sentiment.description: Overall analyst/management tone from the document

executive_summary.description: 3–5 bullet-point summary of the report's key findings

global_signal.description: Overall investment signal derived from the report

confidence_notes.description: Optional notes on data quality, missing fields, or confidence level
